headline: EU Council President proposes €204 billion cut to long-term budget
summary: European Council President Antonio Costa proposed a €204 billion reduction in the EU's long-term budget, including a new tax on Big Tech companies. The proposal faces resistance from France.
why: Budget negotiations determine the funding for EU competitiveness, regional development, and defense. A significant cut could alter the bloc's fiscal priorities and impact major technology firms subject to the proposed tax.

impacts.name: Big Tech
impacts.why: The proposed digital tax would increase the tax burden on large technology companies.
